author: Warhammer
description:
The gifts of Nurgle often cause the body to swell and mutate in quite disturbing ways. Today, Dan is tackling these ‘gifts’ by showing you three different techniques for painting the putrid skin of Nurgle's followers.

Here’s a list of the paints we used in today’s video:

Decaying Dark Skin Tone

Base:
Catachan Flesh
Rakarth Flesh
Layer:
Knight-Questor Flesh
Deepkin Flesh
Contrast:
Akhelian Green
Volupus pink

Putrid Light Skin Tone

Base:
Rakarth Flesh
Layer:
Pallid Wych Flesh
Contrast:
Blood Angels Red
Guilliman Flesh
Volupus Pink

Daemonic Green Skin Tone

Base:
Ionrach Skin
Layer:
Deepkin Flesh
Contrast:
Gutrippa Flesh
Creed Camo
Volupus Pink

Tools:
Small Base Brush STC
Small Dry Brush STC
Small Layer Brush STC
XS Artificer Brush

If you enjoyed this and want to learn more, our YouTube channel has an array of beginner-friendly videos to get you started.
